```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
# ordered
print(rep(5, 7))
```
```{r}
# keywords
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
```{r}
x <- 7
y <- "hello"
z <- TRUE

print(x)
print(class(x))
print(y)
print(class(y))
print(z)
print(class(z))
```
```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543

```

```{r}
# vectors
cell_ID_vector <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated_vector <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before_vector <- c(n_before_1, n_before_2)
n_after_vector <- c(n_after_1, n_after_2)

```
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
bird <- all_my_pets[4]
print(bird)
```
```{r}
# dataframe
cells_id_dataframe <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  n_before = c(5415, 8123),
  n_after = c(1432, 7543)
)

gt(cells_id_dataframe)


```
